name: Richland County, OH
findings: Richland County has 492 nonprofit organizations. 185 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 140 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Richland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 48 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 13 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do economic development organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: No arts and cultural organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?
